description: Audit one GraphQL schema and separate what stops it building from what is legal and costs something. Reports a type implementing an interface without declaring its fields, a reference to an undefined type, a union member that is not an object type, an interface nothing implements, and an absent query root. Separately reports a nullable list item type, which forces every client to handle three outcomes, and a deprecation with no reason. Unreachable types are named as dead weight. Pay 130000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

require_deprecation_reasons.description: Report a deprecation with no reason. Defaults to true, since a deprecation without a replacement tells a client nothing.

schema.description: The schema to audit. GraphQL SDL, read as a documented subset: type, interface, union, enum, input and scalar definitions with arguments, wrappers and defaults. Type extensions and directive definitions are listed as not modelled. Nothing is fetched and no registry is consulted, so the documents supplied are the whole input.

name: graphql_schema_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

valid.description: True only when nothing above applied and nothing was left unaudited. Not a certification and not a style review.

title: GraphQL Schema Audit
